visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor living room, a female creator with long dark wavy hair stands in front of a white fireplace mantel. She is wearing a beige t-shirt and a pinkish skirt. She speaks enthusiastically to the camera, gesturing with her hands. On the mantel behind her are decorative items, including a framed llama painting, flower pots, and soft llama figurines. She holds up two packages of '日日好食' noodles, showing their purple and red branding. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of a white bowl where cooked noodles are being lifted by chopsticks, revealing a rich brown sauce and a garnish of green onions and cilantro. This is followed by a close-up of the raw dried noodle block in its clear tray, and then a shot of noodles being tossed in a white frying pan with tongs on a kitchen stove. The background changes from the living room to a kitchen with tiled walls. (3) Returning to the living room setting, the creator holds a noodle pack and explains the ingredients. She points to the text on the package while maintaining a high-energy facial expression and frequent hand gestures. The lighting remains bright studio-style lighting, and the background ornamentation is consistent. She uses her fingers to emphasize the high protein content and low-carb benefits of the product she is endorsing. (4) A variety of cooked noodle bowls are shown on a white table, all garnished with scallions. The creator continues her talk while holding a larger family-size pack of noodles. A cartoon owl character briefly appears as an overlay. The video ends with her smiling and holding the product close to the camera, giving a final thumbs-up or strong pointing gesture to conclude her enthusiastic recommendation.
